findings.problem: Both prior defects on this key are fixed: «mã xác nhận hoàn tất» is gone (0 occurrences in all 156 vi catalogues) and the Latin «token» is back (58 vi values keep it, per the guide's kept-English list). Judged as asked: «token hoàn tất» does read as a completion token and not as a security token — «hoàn tất» qualifies the mark's completion state, and the clause's own logic (the marks lack it, therefore the marks cannot be cleared) attaches the token to the mark rather than to a sign-in. Residual and non-gating: bare «token» plus an activity modifier can still be parsed as «the token that completes the action», i.e. an authorisation credential — the one reading the English context note forbids. «token báo hoàn tất» («the token that signals completion») closes that parse.
findings.suggested: {count, plural, other {{count, number, ::group-off} dấu chưa đọc không có token báo hoàn tất nên không thể xóa.}} — optional only; keeps «token» Latin, every ICU argument and the ::group-off skeleton byte-identical. The shipped wording is acceptable and this finding does not gate.

per_key_checks.assessment: Accurate and idiomatic: «Đánh dấu N cuộc trò chuyện chưa đọc là đã đọc.» keeps both source facts (the unread set and the read outcome), which the bare Gmail-style «Đánh dấu là đã đọc» would drop. Same clause shape as the sibling receipt ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_cleared «Đã đánh dấu N cuộc trò chuyện là đã đọc». Plain declarative, single full stop.

per_key_checks.current_text: {count, plural, other {Đánh dấu {count, number, ::group-off} cuộc trò chuyện chưa đọc là đã đọc}}, trong đó có {elsewhere, plural, other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} cuộc trò chuyện hiện không hoạt động}}.
per_key_checks.assessment: Prior MINOR: the stiff literal «không đang hoạt động» replaced by «hiện không hoạt động» in both this key and name_suffix_elsewhere (0 / 2 occurrences in the file). Meaning preserved and the subset relation is made explicit by «trong đó có» («of which there are»), so the count is never read as additive; English 'including' is the same relation. The comma sits OUTSIDE the first plural and the only full stop is the final one, as in English. «hoạt động» is the shipped rendering of active (ui.chat.pickers.info_model.active «Đang hoạt động», ui.chat.sidebar_view.active_first «Đang hoạt động trước»); «hiện không hoạt động» states a state, not a section name, and the sidebar has no such heading (mark-all-read.ts: sections are Running / Today / This week / Older).

per_key_checks.assessment: Prior MAJOR fixed: «token» is Latin again and «mã xác nhận» is gone. «dấu chưa đọc» matches the sibling ui.chat.read_ack «Dấu chưa đọc …» and «xóa» matches this feature's own receipt ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_none_cleared «Không có gì được xóa.». The causal «nên» makes explicit the link the source implies and adds no fact; the passive-neutral «không thể xóa» mirrors 'cannot be cleared'. A count of 1 is grammatical in vi (no agreement): «1 dấu chưa đọc không có token hoàn tất nên không thể xóa.»
Joiner carries exactly the two placeholders in source order plus one ASCII space — the correct separator for vi, whose sentences end in '.', so no extra punctuation can creep in. Adds no words.

per_key_checks.current_text: , trong đó có {elsewhere, plural, other {{elsewhere, number, ::group-off} cuộc trò chuyện hiện không hoạt động}}

It names a noun («cuộc trò chuyện»), so the singular case a listener hears has an antecedent even though the visible label carries only «tất cả N»: 'Đánh dấu tất cả 1 đã đọc, trong đó có 1 cuộc trò chuyện hiện không hoạt động'. Label-in-name holds: chat-sidebar.tsx:2348-2364 renders the label span and then the sr-only suffix inside the same Button, and the label string is an exact prefix of the composed name. SAME clause as scope_chats_elsewhere, so the tooltip and the accessible name cannot disagree (the sibling-consistency question raised for fr/es; vi is consistent).

observations: Prior findings: 2 of 2 substantive defects genuinely fixed, verified by quote at head, not by the translator's claim.
Subset semantics: «trong đó có» cannot be read additively, so the elsewhere count stays a subset of the label's count — the property the context sidecar calls out ('never an addition').

Plurals: every message uses `other` only, which is what the binding vi guide mandates ('Vietnamese has no plural agreement; never add one/other branches'). Count 1 renders grammatically without an extra arm; there is no singular/plural inconsistency of the kind flagged for es, because vi has no singular form to disagree with.

Label-in-name: composed name 'Đánh dấu tất cả 3 đã đọc, trong đó có 2 cuộc trò chuyện hiện không hoạt động'; the label is an exact prefix (verified by string composition) and the suffix carries the leading comma the code does not add.

Terminology: «cuộc trò chuyện» consistent with the file and siblings (row_menu.rename «Đổi tên cuộc trò chuyện»); «dấu chưa đọc» matches ui.chat.read_ack; «xóa» matches ui.notices.chat.mark_all_read_none_cleared; «hoàn tất» matches ui.settings.imports.state_done; «hoạt động» matches ui.chat.pickers.info_model.active; «token» matches ui.mesh and ui.settings.account.

Typography: ASCII comma plus one space, no space before punctuation, one full stop per sentence and none doubled, no '!', sentence case, no Title Case, no curly quotes needed in these five strings; all five values are NFC (codepoint comparison) with no Cf/Cc or bidi control characters.

Mechanical: vi/ui.chat.sidebar.json is valid JSON with 86 keys against 86 English keys, nothing added or dropped; every argument keeps its source name and order and every numeric formatter is exactly {n, number, ::group-off}; plural/select structures are brace-balanced and nest as in the source; no markup, code span, flag or identifier appears in these strings.

Fit: the sidecar supplies no maxCells/maxChars for these keys, the tooltip may wrap natively, and the suffix is sr-only text rather than width-budgeted control text, so no overflow finding was raised; the visible label's width is out of this audit's five-key scope.
RTL/bidi: not applicable to vi; recorded for completeness, no bidi isolation or mirroring question arises here.
